description: This file contains utility functions and constants for parsing command-line arguments related to test execution configurations, such as option sets and filter parsing.

methods.name: parsePassthroughArgs
methods.description: Parses an array of command-line arguments into file filters and option arguments, distinguishing between options and positional filters.

methods.name: countExplicitEntryFilters
methods.description: Counts the number of explicit file filters provided in command-line arguments.

methods.name: getExplicitEntryFilters
methods.description: Retrieves the list of explicit file filters from command-line arguments.
